injects.title: Initial Flood Warning Activation
injects.description: ARC Issue Date: 13th July (D-14 Days). Western Disturbances coinciding with peak monsoon activity. Active rainfall zone over north Arabian Sea. Max Reservoir Capacity of Tarbela Dam expected. Activate hill torrents in Punjab and Kirthar Range.

injects.title: Tarbela Dam at Max Capacity
injects.description: Heavy rainfall in Upper Indus Basin continues. Tarbela Reservoir hits max capacity. Low-Pressure System developed over KP, Punjab, and upper Sindh. Inundation risks in critical districts of River Indus & tributaries escalate.
